title: HZDR Summer Student Program 2027
field: Natural sciences, life sciences, medicine and engineering

about: HZDR in Dresden, Germany, invites students from around the world to apply for its 2027 Summer Student Program, with placements between July and September 2027. A letter of recommendation must arrive before the 24 January 2027 deadline.
